snippet.title: Modulink - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Modulink on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4952760/Modulink/

Modulink is a third-person action roguelite set in a hopeful post-apocalyptic world, where knowledge is your most powerful weapon. Discover mysterious Modules, learn how they work, and combine them into circuits that change your abilities. Fight deadly machines and use what you learn to repair the world.
